question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
years AS (
    SELECT 0 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
check_points AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        l.gender,
        y.year_offset,
        date_trunc('year', CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL (y.year_offset) YEAR) + INTERVAL (1) YEAR - INTERVAL (1) DAY AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators l ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.id_bioguide,
        cp.gender,
        lt.state,
        cp.year_offset,
        cp.check_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cp.check_date AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cp.check_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_retained
    FROM check_points cp
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON cp.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY cp.id_bioguide, cp.gender, lt.state, cp.year_offset, cp.check_date
),
state_gender_year AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        year_offset,
        SUM(is_retained) as retained_count,
        COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
state_gender_qualifies AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(*) as year_points_with_retention
    FROM state_gender_year
    WHERE retained_count > 0
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM state_gender_qualifies
WHERE gender IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
ORDER BY state

        date_trunc('year', CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL (y.year_offset) YEAR) + INTERVAL (1) YEAR - INTERVAL (1) DAY AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators l ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.id_bioguide,
        cp.gender,
        lt.state,
        cp.year_offset,
        cp.check_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cp.check_date AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cp.check_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_retained
    FROM check_points cp
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON cp.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY cp.id_bioguide, cp.gender, lt.state, cp.year_offset, cp.check_date
),
state_gender_year AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        year_offset,
        SUM(is_retained) as retained_count,
        COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
state_gender_qualifies AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(*) as year_points_with_retention
    FROM state_gender_year
    WHERE retained_count > 0
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM state_gender_qualifies
WHERE gender IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
ORDER BY state
